stance_rationale: The package has a valid multi-date alpha_scores artifact, but the selected signal violates or at least materially bypasses PIT-C13 by adding a second IC-based sign layer on top of Z_Score_Aligned. Mandatory DSR/multi-testing evidence, challenge_note governance, and costed fund-of-fund harness evidence are missing, so the current draft should not graduate.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/alpha_scores.parquet has 52800 rows, sig_date x Ticker x alpha x confidence, monthly no-gap dates, and time-varying ticker counts. The user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260511_001 path is absent.

rf_a2.evidence: composite ICIR=0.8684 > best single factor ICIR=0.7105

rf_a3.evidence: recent P3 ICIR=0.7677 is not > full ICIR x 1.5

rf_a4.evidence: reported sector-neutral retention does not show a 50%+ collapse, but raw-vs-sector-neutral final artifact is incomplete

rf_a5.evidence: script filters ADV_20d >= 2e8 before scoring; top-decile liquidity table is still not separately persisted

rf_a6.evidence: 5 candidates/specs were tried, DSR is pending, and 5-spec CAPM/Carhart/FF regression evidence is absent

rf_a7.evidence: alpha_scores is multi-date; weights.csv is absent so downstream schedule cannot be verified

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Factor DB Z_Score_Aligned is multiplied again by dir_D43/dir_D41/dir_D58 from an internal expanding IC layer; C13 requires Z_Score_Aligned only and forbids manual sign flips.
load_month_factors is C14-aware, but the second direction-alignment IC history is created from ret_1M with no persisted Usable_Date audit.
Selected factor values are loaded through load_month_factors(); direct parquet reads are for raw price/volume and benchmark diagnostics.
No regime or overlay signal is used to form the alpha; crisis buckets are diagnostic only.
No fundamental statement factors are used.

critical_concerns.description: The final alpha is not simply Factor DB Z_Score_Aligned: it applies an additional expanding IC sign multiplier to D43/D41/D58. Even if lagged, this is a manual sign layer outside the C13-approved interface and makes the strongest IC evidence non-compliant until rerun without dir_* multipliers.

RF-A6 is active: five candidate/spec paths were tried, the selected objective is ICIR, DSR is explicitly pending, and the required 5-spec regression battery is missing. A Harvey t-stat on the chosen composite plus subfactors is not a multi-testing correction.

The package leans on standalone Top20 IC/SR and S4 correlation to justify a new sleeve, but AX-007 says single_sleeve_long_only_top20 breaks the signal-portfolio mechanism unless a real exception is proven. A three-factor D-family composite is not sufficient evidence of a fund-of-fund exception.

Turnover is presented as 556.2% annual one-way, while the validation note says actual round-trip is roughly 2x. That implies possible turnover above the 600% hard constraint before optimizer smoothing, so the reported Top20 SR is not decision-grade without a costed walk-forward harness.

No challenge_note.md exists, the requested risk/optimization packages and weights/covariance artifacts are absent, and artifact_lineage has null input hashes plus a reproduction command pointing to run_all.R, which is not present. This fails No Silent Override and weakens AX-008 triangulation.

The academic mechanism cites papers but not pages, and the KR-specific mechanism is inferred from the same backtest rather than separately validated. This leaves the lottery/vol-of-vol story vulnerable to post-hoc rationalization.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001 passes the core time-series dimension check: 155 monthly sig_dates, 2011-01-01 to 2023-11-01, no missing months, 303-351 tickers per date.
Headline IC diagnostics clear basic thresholds: rank_IC=0.0741, ICIR=0.8684, NW-t=8.6205, subperiod_stability=1.0, monotonicity=0.9879.
RF-A2 and RF-A3 are not triggered: composite ICIR exceeds every single factor, and recent subperiod ICIR is not an extreme recent-only spike.
Liquidity filtering appears PIT-aware at the universe stage through t-1 trade-day ADV_20d >= 2e8, but top-decile liquidity/capacity output is not separately persisted.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the second expanding direction-alignment layer is allowed under PIT-C13 despite Z_Score_Aligned already encoding direction.
DSR >= 0.50 is not computed; the package defers it to Judge stage.
No costed combined S4 + new sleeve walk-forward harness is provided, so SR gap closure is asserted rather than verified.
weights.csv and covariance.parquet for WT-D20260511_001 are absent, so weight schedule, PSD, and condition-number checks cannot be audited.
challenge_note.md is absent, so RF-A1-A7 handling is embedded in the package rather than governed as Charter §8 requires.
Correlation with existing PG2 active strategies beyond S4 baseline is not reported.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that a manually re-aligned D-family Top20 signal with strong standalone IC and negative S4 correlation will survive PIT-C13, multi-testing, turnover costs, and AX-007 once inserted into the real S4 fund-of-fund harness.
rebuttal_required: Rerun FINAL_3axis using only Factor DB Z_Score_Aligned with no dir_D43/dir_D41/dir_D58 multiplier, then report delta rank_IC, ICIR, t_NW, monotonicity, and subperiod stability.
Compute DSR with the full candidate count and provide CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regression outputs.
Produce challenge_note.md covering RF-A1-A7 and regenerate artifact_lineage with non-null hashes and an executable reproduction command.
Provide a costed S4 + proposed sleeve walk-forward harness with weights schedule, turnover <600%, MDD <45%, and 15bps one-way costs.
Persist top-decile liquidity/capacity diagnostics and PG2 active-strategy correlation.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The numeric IC evidence is not enough because the disputed claims depend on process compliance, artifact reproducibility, and integrated costed portfolio behavior that are not independently verified.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the factor keep t_NW > 2.95 and DSR >= 0.50 after removing the extra direction sign layer and counting all tried specs?
Is every IC observation used for direction alignment backed by an explicit Usable_Date <= sig_date audit trail?
Does the proposed sleeve improve S4 net SR after 15bps costs while keeping turnover <600% and MDD <45%?
Which AX-007 exception is being claimed: true multi-sleeve integration, 50+ diversification, long-short, or ML sizing?
